verdict.rationale: Maritime runs agents in per-agent micro-VMs and Linux desktops, so network egress control is a fair question for this platform. However, no evidence documents any outbound network policy, allowlist or denylist. The closest items are API key scopes and secret injection into the VM, which are adjacent access controls, not egress restriction.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy
